Entry requirements · 2027 entry

Law LLB at University of Bristol

What University of Bristol asks of applicants to Law LLB for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

UK · All University of Bristol courses · Law field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 7 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • For applicants with a US high-school diploma: SAT/ACT is not generally required — Bristol does not generally require standardised tests (Law requires LNAT; Medicine requires UCAT)
  • SAT (evidence-based reading and writing section only) at 650+ or ACT at 28+ may count as one of the three additional qualifications needed alongside the diploma (GPA 3.2 minimum, 3.4 for competitive courses)
Verified19 Oct 2026Bristol: USA – entry requirements
English language
  • Bristol English language Profile B
  • IELTS 7.0 overall with 7.0 in writing and 6.5 in all other skills
  • TOEFL iBT:
    • 95 overall with R22, L21, S23, W24 (tests up to 20 Jan 2026)
    • 5 overall, 5 in writing and 4.5 in all other skills (tests from 21 Jan 2026)
  • Pearson PTE Academic 71 overall with no lower than 71 in writing and 67 in all other skills
  • GCSE English Language grade B/6 also accepted

Required if English is not the applicant’s first language.

Verified19 Oct 2026Bristol: LLB Law (2027 entry) · Bristol: English language Profile B
Admissions tests
  • LNAT — required for all applicants; must be taken before the January UCAS deadline stated on the LNAT website
  • The LNAT essay is read and assessed by University of Bristol staff
Verified19 Oct 2026Bristol: Admissions Statement 2027 – Law · Bristol: USA – entry requirements
Subject prerequisites
  • No required subjects stated
  • No prior legal study is required
Verified19 Oct 2026Bristol: LLB Law (2027 entry) · Bristol: Admissions Statement 2027 – Law

Other qualifications
  • Advanced Placement:
    • 3 AP exams at grades 4, 4, 4
    • Minimum GPA 3.2
  • Official: US high-school diploma with GPA 3.2 minimum (3.4 for competitive courses) plus three additional qualifications — AP tests at 4 or above (more commonly 5), AP classes over two semesters, Honors classes, dual-enrolment courses, SAT/ACT, IB Higher Level courses or A levels

Official (2027 entry): high-school diploma with GPA 3.2 minimum (3.4 for competitive courses) and three additional qualifications; AP tests count at a score of at least 4 (more commonly 5). Bristol does not say which courses count as competitive, and APs are one of several qualification types that can make up the three.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026Bristol: USA – entry requirements
Other requirements
  • Applications are assessed on academic record (GCSE and A-level or equivalent) together with the LNAT score
  • LNAT essay: Bristol looks for the ability to make and sustain a persuasive argument and a strong command of language
  • Personal statement and reference are not normally considered — used only to separate applicants with the same academic score
  • Not routinely interviewed (interviews only in exceptional circumstances)
Verified19 Oct 2026Bristol: Admissions Statement 2027 – Law
